concept.hr: Kašnjenje prijenosa, širenja, obrade i čekanja u redu na jednom skoku
concept.en: Transmission, propagation, processing and queuing delay over one hop

summary.hr: Mijenjaj veličinu paketa, brzinu veze, udaljenost i opterećenje: svaka postavka pomiče samo svoj dio trake od šest dijelova kašnjenja.
summary.en: Change packet size, link rate, distance and load: each setting moves only its own part of a six-part delay bar over one router.

concept.hr: 10 Mb/s ili 1 Gb/s: mijenja se prijenos, širenje ostaje 0,49 ms
concept.en: 10 Mb/s or 1 Gb/s: transmission changes, propagation stays 0.49 ms

concept.hr: 100 m ili 7000 km vlakna: mijenja se širenje, prijenos ostaje isti
concept.en: 100 m or 7000 km of fibre: propagation changes, transmission stays

concept.hr: Geostacionarni satelit: oko 239 ms u jednom smjeru samo od širenja
concept.en: A geostationary satellite: about 239 ms one way from propagation alone

concept.hr: Opterećenje 90 %: red dodaje 1,08 ms, a veza je ista
concept.en: 90 % load: the queue adds 1.08 ms on the same link

concept.hr: 64 B umjesto 1500 B na 10 Mb/s: prijenos s 1,2 na 0,051 ms
concept.en: 64 B instead of 1500 B at 10 Mb/s: transmission from 1.2 to 0.051 ms
